# pi-foreman

> Orchestration harness for the pi coding agent: roles, a model ladder, review gates, safety guards and a requirements ledger.

pi-foreman is a Pi package (extensions, agent roles, skills) with a stdlib-only Python core and a Node installer. It runs on Linux, macOS and Windows. Private and organisation overlays consume released versions and never patch it.

## Docs

- [Feature overview](docs/features.md): full feature inventory; read this first to set up
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): instructions for coding agents working on the repo, and the docs-by-area index
- [Install and configure](docs/install.md): package install, `foreman setup` (`--profile`, `--enable`, `--disable`, `--addon`, `--pick`), config layers, update and remove
- [Tools](docs/tools.md): optional git tool pack (`tools.git`), PR tools (`tools.pr`, `tools.prHost`), caps, guards, child inheritance, trace
- [Idle prompt cache](docs/cache.md): per-provider cache policy, keep-alive, warm compaction, cost and privacy
- [Permissions](docs/permissions.md): the tool gate: `permissions.json` rules, prose whitelist, modes, dangerous class and classifier, floors, owner dialog, profiles
- [Overlays](docs/overlays.md): private and organisation overlays, extension points
- [Orchestration design](docs/orchestration-design.md): when subagents earn their place, the single-loop alternative, and the open questions for roles and delegation
